steps.name: Ordnance survey of the jet models (artsrc/jets/loadouts.py)
Weapon families: missiles, bombs, rockets, guns (weapons/jet-ordnance.yaml)
Procedural missiles for jets modelled without weapons (artsrc/jets/ordnance.py)
Missiles disappear when fired, jets fly home empty to rearm (tested: A-10)
Real smoke trails instead of contrail lines (WithPxJetTrail)
Render every jet with its weapon overlays
Balance: one air-to-air missile per pass, guns weaker vs aircraft (dogfight now lasts 15-40 s)
Realistic shot-down jets: fireball, spinning fall with fire and black smoke, debris, burning crash site (WithPxCrashFx)
